mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(receivable_amount), 0) AS totalReceivable, IFNULL(SUM(received_amount), 0) AS totalReceived, IFNULL(SUM(unpaid_amount), 0) AS totalUnpaid, COUNT(1) AS billCount, SUM(CASE WHEN bill_status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paidBillCount, SUM(CASE WHEN bill_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partialBillCount, SUM(CASE WHEN bill_status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaidBillCount FROM community_fee_bill fb LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = fb.room_id

SELECT bill_year AS billYear, bill_month AS billMonth, CONCAT(bill_year, '-', LPAD(bill_month, 2, '0')) AS statMonth, IFNULL(SUM(receivable_amount), 0) AS receivableAmount, IFNULL(SUM(received_amount), 0) AS receivedAmount, IFNULL(SUM(unpaid_amount), 0) AS unpaidAmount, COUNT(1) AS billCount FROM community_fee_bill fb LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = fb.room_id
GROUP BY bill_year, bill_month ORDER BY bill_year ASC, bill_month ASC

SELECT item_id AS itemId, item_name AS itemName, IFNULL(SUM(receivable_amount), 0) AS receivableAmount, IFNULL(SUM(received_amount), 0) AS receivedAmount, IFNULL(SUM(unpaid_amount), 0) AS unpaidAmount, COUNT(1) AS billCount FROM community_fee_bill fb LEFT JOIN room r ON r.room_id = fb.room_id
GROUP BY item_id, item_name ORDER BY receivedAmount DESC, receivableAmount DESC
